input.behavior_to_protect: A node that appears only as a dependency (never as a graph key) must still be scheduled before the nodes that depend on it.

description: Write one regression scenario where node C appears only as a dependency of B (never as a graph key); C must appear in the output before B. The scenario must fail a mutant that only schedules nodes that appear as keys in the input mapping.
requirements: Return one JSON test scenario using only the supplied values. It must make the correct behavior pass and the named mutant fail.
